metadata.name: GetExtendedManualStatus
metadata.description: This API is to get the details of the manual status.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 7314145404 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number(Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

response_fields.name: CurrencySymbol
response_fields.description: This tag reflects the currency symbol

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: ManualStatus
children.description: Current Manual Status  of account assigned manually Valid Values: Please refer appendix section 5.21 Card/Account Statuses for a valid set of values. Example: 2 - Active, 3 - Delinquent, 4 - Overlimit, 7 - Fraud, 10 - Blocked, 11 - Closed

children.name: AccountDerivedStatus
children.description: Account Derived status based on Account Status, Card Manual Status and Embossing Status. Valid Values: Please refer appendix section 5.21 Card/Account Statuses for a valid set of values. Example: 2 - Active, 3 - Delinquent, 4 - Overlimit, 7 - Fraud, 10 - Blocked, 11 - Closed

children.name: Priority
children.description: Priority of the Manual Status given for an account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: X Example:1,2

children.name: ManualStatus
children.description: Status of account assigned manually Valid Values: Please refer appendix section 5.21 Card/Account Statuses for a valid set of values. Example: 2 - Active, 3 - Delinquent, 4 - Overlimit, 7 - Fraud, 10 - Blocked, 11 - Closed Allowable Values: 19

children.name: StatusDescription
children.description: Manual Status Description. Valid Values:0-9,A-Z Format:XXXXXX Example: blocked by customer, active Allowable Values: 50

children.name: StartDate
children.description: Start date of the Manual Status of an account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 02/02/2019 00:00:00

children.name: EndDate
children.description: End date of the Manual Status of an account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 02/02/2019 00:00:00

children.name: UserID
children.description: User ID by which the manual status of the account has been updated. Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Format: XXXX Example: USER1 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: IsDeleted
children.description: This tag is to confirm if the record is been deleted or not. Valid Values: Y,N Format: X Example: Y,N

children.name: EffectiveEndDate
children.description: Effective End date of the Manual Status for an account Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example: 02/02/2019 00:00:00

children.name: ApplicantType
children.description: The type of Applicants. Valid Values:Valid Values: 1, 2, 3 Example: 1 = Applicant, 2 = Co-Applicant, 3 = Cosigner
